name: 一起初来丸
overview:
Rikimaru's new video project.

Catch up with old friends and new—dive into the latest trends, play around with global memes, swap life stories, get answers to your questions, and explore how people from different cultures grow while staying true to themselves.

No matter what pop culture you're into, you’ll find your tribe here. It’s where young minds meet—mixing different scenes, cultures, and trends in one vibrant space.
